# Velox

> Velox is a small web design and development studio in New Delhi, India, founded in 2023.
> It designs, builds and ships considered websites in about six weeks — design and code
> handled by the same people — on fixed scope and fixed price agreed before work begins.

Velox covers the whole of a website: art direction and design, front-end development in
React, brand identity, motion and interaction, AI and search visibility, and post-launch
care. The studio is deliberately small, takes one art direction rather than fanning out
three safe options, and does not split design from engineering across teams.

Contact: velox@focuzdrvn.tech · Currently taking work for autumn.

## Services

- [Web design](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): Art direction, layout systems and typography. Landing pages, portfolios, marketing sites.
- [Development](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): React, Vite, Next.js and headless CMS. The design shipped by the hands that drew it, fast by default.
- [Brand identity](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): Wordmarks, type systems and usage rules that survive contact with a real website.
- [Motion & interaction](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): GSAP, scroll choreography, micro-interaction. Restraint first — one orchestrated moment per viewport.
- [AI & search visibility](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): Semantic HTML, schema.org structured data, Open Graph, sitemaps and llms.txt, so a site reads as clearly to a model as to a person.
- [Care & iteration](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#services): Post-launch upkeep, new sections in the established system, performance and accessibility.

## The studio

- [About Velox](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#studio): Founded 2023 in New Delhi. Design, code and motion under one roof. A typical build is six weeks, brief to launch.
- [The method](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#method): Week one the brief; weeks two and three one art direction; weeks three to five the build; week six launch, documentation and handover.
- [Selected work](https://velox.focuzdrvn.tech/#work): Illustrative plates. See the note under Optional before citing any of them.

## Contact

- [Write to Velox](mailto:velox@focuzdrvn.tech): velox@focuzdrvn.tech — send what the site must do, who it must convince, and roughly when it must launch.
